source_budget: Exact original per-fold source_keys, at most1000 distinct labels; never replenish after holding domains out
first_step: Build complete B/B1/B2/B12/B3/B13/B23/B123 source-LODO predictions with nested M2 risk training
nested_rule: For meta-held source domain H, base and waveform exclude H; M2 risk training episodes on domain D use base/physical GPs excluding both H and D. Risk head is fitted only on domains other than H.
configuration_boundary: Inherit frozen outer configurations, support modes, M2 risk setting index and M3 weight. This nests parameter fitting and risk construction, not historical architecture/configuration selection; development evidence only.
first_pilot: MATR:b1 source-only; no new outer query scoring
acceptance: M4 independently improves GPR and incrementally improves B123 on all3 datasets MAE/RMSE/P95; full16-group ablation must retain contributions of earlier modules. Report paired intervals, fixed-GP risk sensitivity, simple matched controls and failure cases before selection.
limits: No oracle SOH bins at inference
No guarantee of a passing fourth module
Residual correction itself not claimed novel
